patches.purpose: Normalize unknown reasoning effort to low while preserving explicit high and max.
patches.upstream_reference: Mia docker-compose.dspark.yml inline reasoning normalization at f752cd04ab30f2cf42077dd8811a5e1e682d63e7

patches.purpose: Accept already-decoded tool-call argument objects in the official DeepSeek V4 encoding.
Implement V2 thinking-budget state on the GPU sampler path.
Preserve complete tool calls when completion output is truncated.
Route NVFP4 DS MLA long-context decode to the supported fast kernel path.
Backport the conditional MTP hidden-state buffer allocation.
Backport the short-context indexer top-k skip.
Backport the dormant dense-prefill indexer scoring skip.
Backport empty C128 compressor launch avoidance.
Advance structured-output grammar across the reasoning boundary.
patches.upstream_reference: vLLM pull request 44993 and Mia issue 24

patches.purpose: Correct scheduler accounting for partial-prefill concurrency.
Add decode fairness and scheduler diagnostics.
Keep hybrid SWA common-hit calculation from shrinking valid cache hits.
Keep client stop strings dormant while the model is inside reasoning output.
patches.upstream_reference: Mia suppress-stops reasoning hotfix at f752cd04ab30f2cf42077dd8811a5e1e682d63e7

document.removal_condition: Remove each patch only after the exact base vLLM revision incorporates the same behavior and two-Spark qualification is repeated.
